summary: Few points end in an ask; how many asks a speech makes is the speaker's trait and the kind of speech.
realLife: Only 15% of points ended in an ask, and asks per speech ran from none (Lincoln, Lujan Grisham) to eight (Hobbs).
sources: docs/story/research/address-moves.md (Elections lane, Nov 24, 2026: 6 inaugurals and 6 State of the State addresses read whole, 175 points coded)
inGame: The `call` section is optional and its shapes (call-alone, address-run) are picked by the speaker's trait `pull`, so asks per speech vary with the speaker; there is no per-point ask.

turns.what: Asks in most points, as Arizona's governor did (eight in one speech).
turns.pulledBy: a speaker high in assertive or work-centered; a state kind with a legislature that holds a bill
turns.writesBack: The talk at home can reply to several asks; a promise record can follow each.
